Hospital billing slows down at one question at the counter: "Which GST rate is this one?" The bill is written up, the GST is worked out on a calculator, and the evening queue waits while someone checks it twice.

FineHealth by Fine Solves puts GST-ready billing in the same system as registration, OPD and IPD, prescriptions and reports, so the bill is raised from one patient record instead of rebuilt by hand at the counter.

How many bills at your counter still go through a calculator before they print?
